This is my plot, only small, and I grow maize with pigeon pea between the rows so the soil gets some help and we have something else to eat. I am hoping for the coupon this year — last season I got one and it made a big difference, the maize grew tall. If I receive it, I will put a little NPK at planting and urea when the maize is knee-high; if I don't get the coupon, I cannot afford to buy fertilizer at the shop price. I also spread the manure we collect from the goats around the house. I do the work myself with my children — we do not have money to hire people, maybe just one or two days if the weeding gets behind because of the rain.
